title: Which Agent Tool Should You Use?
description:
Which tool should you actually use to build an AI agent? Here's the honest take, no sponsorships involved. Just want something working and you're not technical? Use a no-code tool like Genspark or a setup inside Claude Code. 

Need real logic, branching, and lots of service connections but don't want to manage a codebase? Go low-code with an automation platform, great for simple agents. Want a genuinely powerful agent that runs in production without building from scratch? Use a harness like OpenCode. Need full control to integrate deep into your own product? 

Use an AI framework like LangGraph and write it in full code.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer
